issue.title: Conflict between Resource class attribute and new almanac interface endpoints

summary.text: The verifier reproduced the original issue, but found a regression: the existing test test_endpoint_shadowing in phabricator/tests/test_phabricator.py passed before the fix and fails after it, so this fix is a counterexample, not a confirmed fix. Look first at why test_endpoint_shadowing now fails, since it likely covers the same Resource-attribute-versus-endpoint naming conflict this fix changes.
